title: The subdivision last-vertex map is a weak homotopy equivalence
statement: Use small simplicial sets, geometric realization and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] and [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For a small simplicial set $T$, let $\operatorname{Sd}T$ be the degreewise colimit over its category of simplices of $N(\mathcal P_+([n]))$, where $\mathcal P_+([n])$ consists of nonempty subsets ordered by inclusion and a monotone map acts by taking images. Let $\lambda_T:\operatorname{Sd}T\to T$ be induced on each simplex $\sigma:\Delta^n\to T$ by the map $N(\mathcal P_+([n]))\to\Delta^n$ sending a subset to its maximum. These are the subdivision and last-vertex map of [lem-coef-subdivision-face-poset-calculus]. For every such $T$, $\lambda_T$ is a weak homotopy equivalence: its realization is bijective on path components and induces isomorphisms on all homotopy groups at every source basepoint.
